author: claude
summary: Plan-coverage follow-up: implements 3 findings from docs/design-critique/voices-variants-round2/01-findings.md (F3.1, F3.2, F5.7) that no task in the voices-variants-round2 plan actually addressed. F3.1: tint the Overview/metadata-editor attribute section headers (CLASS/GENDER/AGE/ACCENT/PACE/etc.) with the same --pill-{category}-text hue their values render as pills under, so header hue matches pill hue (Gestalt similarity). F3.2: the metadata editor's active chip now paints with that facet's --pill-* tokens instead of a single generic --accent for every field. F5.7: grows the voice-catalog-card avatar 40px -> 56px and its play/pause overlay button 24px -> 44px (mobile override too) to clear the WCAG 2.5.5 44px touch-target floor now that the avatar doubles as a play target.

files.change: Added and exported categoryForAttributeKey(key): PillCategory -- the same core-key -> hue mapping voicePillsFromMetadata already used internally, now shared so OneSelect/ManySelect/OverviewTab/chip can derive a field's pill hue instead of re-deriving it.

chip() takes a new optional `category?: PillCategory` param (F3.2). When provided, the active/selected state paints with that facet's --pill-{category}-bg/-border/-text tokens instead of the previous generic --accent fill; callers that omit it (free-form tag chips in TagAutocompleteInput/VariantFilterBar) keep the prior accent-fill styling unchanged.

F3.1: tints the section header's color to var(--pill-{category}-text) via categoryForAttributeKey(section.key). F3.2: passes that category through to chip() so accent/pace's active chips match their pill hue instead of generic accent.
Same as OneSelect.tsx -- tints the header and passes category to chip() for the many-value fields (language/style/tone/timbre/use_case/quality), all of which map to the 'extended' hue.

F3.1 only (class/gender/age render via SearchableSelect, not chip.tsx, since task 006): tints the inline CLASS/GENDER/AGE combobox header labels to their pill hue via categoryForAttributeKey, matching the summary pills in VoiceDetailHeader above.
F5.7: .voice-catalog-card__avatar 40px -> 56px; .voice-catalog-card__avatar-play-btn (base rule and the 375px mobile-breakpoint override, which previously shrank it back to 30px) both set to 44px.

spec_version 1.15.0 -> 1.16.0, changelog row added. Section 2.4: added --pill-*-text-on-surface/-surface-alt contrast rows (computed, all pass AA; light-theme low point 4.92 for extended on surface-alt, dark-theme low point 8.43 for class on surface) plus a binding-rules bullet explaining this is a different pairing than the existing pill-text-on-pill-bg rows. Section 8.4: noted the voice-catalog-card play-overlay touch-target instance of the previously-tracked '44px hit-area for compact icon buttons' follow-up as resolved.

flow_impact: Pure visual/a11y polish on the Voice Lab overview/metadata editor and the Voices catalog card; no data-model, routing, or API changes. categoryForAttributeKey() and chip()'s new category param are now the shared pill-hue mapping any future facet-styled control (filters, other editors) should reuse rather than re-deriving.
flagged_pre_existing_issue: None introduced. Confirmed the findings' 'VoicesTabHeader already tints active facet chips correctly via ACTIVE_CHIP_STYLE' premise is stale -- CLASS/GENDER/AGE filters were converted to MultiSelect comboboxes (task 005, generic --accent styling, no facet-hue map) before this task ran, so F3.2 reused VoicePill's own category->token mapping as the smallest-reasonable-call source of truth instead.
